calc.add.hitDa: Line above the low-resolution adducts table when the observed m/z matches; {adduct} with superscripts (HTML), {ppm} signed error in Da with two decimals.
calc.add.noneDa: Line above the low-resolution table when no adduct matches; {tol} = tolerance in Da.
cq.all: Button that opens all rows of a group of candidates; {n} = total number of rows.
cq.none: Line below the calculator when nothing matches the number; {tol} = tolerance with unit (e.g. "5 ppm" or "0.5 Da").
